findings.title: NPA cut history is evaluated as the current calendar year
findings.source_quote: Auf 50 % der nichtproduktiven Ackerflächen ist je Kalenderjahr Mähen/Häckseln frühestens am 1. August erlaubt
findings.impact: regular_cuts does not filter dates by evaluation year. Historical cuts inflate the current maximum, falsely satisfy the biennial duty, and consume the current early-use quota. Three independent source-derived probes reproduce all directions; two exact-half/all-area controls behave correctly.

findings.title: Missing agroforest definition facts still establish a positive definition
findings.source_quote: Agroforststreifen müssen eine durchschnittliche Breite von mindestens 2 m und maximal 10 m aufweisen
findings.impact: All relevant checks are violation-oriented and several require a fact already to exist. An empty agroforest object yields no definition violations, afs_meets_definition=true and can contribute area to the native premium estimate. This is not merely a missing UI field; the native positive predicate lacks required evidence.

findings.title: Undefined density is silently treated as a satisfied definition
findings.source_quote: mit einer Dichte von mindestens 10 bis maximal 25 Bäumen pro 100 Laufmeter
findings.impact: A zero or absent length makes trees_per_100_m undefined and skips the density violation. The absence-of-violations definition still succeeds. A complete typed input contract must reject or withhold assessment for this impossible/unevidenced ratio.

findings.title: Approved browsing protection can also trigger the universal PSM ban
findings.source_quote:
Zulässig ist nur der Einsatz von gemäß Bio-
Verordnung (EU) 2018/848 zugelassenem Verbissschutz bei Bäumen und Sträuchern.
findings.impact: The probe declares the permitted browsing protection as the only actual PSM use. With psm_used=true the universal ban still emits AFS-006 despite BIO approval. If the intended field excludes this permitted exception, that convention must be explicit in the input contract and validated upstream. No claim is made that every real browsing product legally is a PSM.

findings.title: Negative-list species matching needs a canonical taxonomic contract
findings.impact: A botanical name with authorship, Robinia pseudoacacia L., bypasses the bare-name equality. A contract accepting only canonical binomials must normalize or reject this before evaluation. Separately, the fertile-Paulownia qualifier in the source has no corresponding input fact; that is recorded without inventing a sterile-tree oracle.

findings.title: The guaranteed band is a raw estimate before control and sanction consequences
findings.source_quote: Garantiert ist dabei der angegebene Mindestbetrag.
findings.impact: The band is correctly gated on contract_valid, unlike a completely unconditional amount. However, control refusal and sanction/exclusion helpers do not adjust it; guaranteed_eur must not be shown as an approved payable minimum. A management breach does not automatically mean zero; general/legal co-review resolves the exact consequences.

findings.title: Growing-season vegetation is catalogued but not executable
findings.source_quote: (3) Zur Erhaltung der Flächen in einem zufriedenstellenden agronomischen Zustand muss die Fläche über die Vegetationsperiode zumindest eine Begrünung aufweisen.
findings.impact: NPA-019 preserves the GSP duty with no executable symbols. The proposed NPA object records establishment but not evidence of required vegetation under the applicable timing and exceptions. The generic minimum-management exemption does not waive this specific GSP/conditionality duty. The full GSP read and temporal applicability are bound by the general/legal reviewer.
findings.scope_note: The finding does not prescribe uninterrupted April–September cover: permitted sowing and breaking dates, self-greening and other applicable exceptions must be reconciled when implementing the duty.
